gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
I can't wait to see you again.

gaps.explanation: deny having + past participle denies an earlier action.

gaps.lead: She cooked a huge meal, but we had already eaten.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it happened although it wasn't necessary.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.
